test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Raghav said to Meera, “Are you upset with me?”

options.text: Raghav asked Meera if she was upset with her.
Raghav asked Meera if she was upset with him.
Raghav asked Meera if she was upset with me.
Raghav asked Meera why she was upset with him.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Raghav asked Meera if she was upset with him. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in **direct speech**, where Raghav directly asked Meera if she was upset with him.
 
• In reported speech, we need to change the sentence to reflect that it was said in the past and reported by someone else.
